prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clearly adult woman at a fictional jewelry exhibition gala, standing in a graceful poised stance against a soft pink event wall. She has a sophisticated low ponytail with wispy bangs framing her face, calm elegant expression, luminous natural makeup, warm peach lips and cheeks, and realistic skin pores. She wears a strapless mint-green gown with pleated fabric bands arranged in a crisscross bodice pattern and a frothy feathered or ruffled skirt beginning at the hips. Add a multi-strand white-gold diamond necklace, matching bracelet, and prominent diamond cocktail ring. Use one abstract decorative motif on the pink backdrop, no real brand or event marks. Cinematic diffused light at approximately 5000K with subtle warm fill creates soft highlights on diamonds, mint fabric, feathers, and skin. Capture a vertical full-length portrait with an 85mm lens, restrained dewy highlights, realistic pleat and feather detail, and subtle film grain. Use an approved adult model rather than a public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, celebrity likeness, recognizable public figures, real brand logos, transparent fabric, visible intimate areas, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted anatomy, illegible text
